nodes.name: Preload bootstrap
nodes.summary: Exposes window.electronAPI via contextBridge; resolves workspace id/ws port through sendSync, builds RoutedClient + initial WsRpcClient and calls buildClientApi(client, CHANNEL_MAP).

nodes.name: CHANNEL_MAP method-channel map
nodes.summary: Single source of truth mapping ElectronAPI method names to RPC_CHANNELS entries via invoke()/listener() helpers; dotted keys become nested namespaces.

nodes.name: buildClientApi proxy builder
nodes.summary: Turns a ChannelMap into an ElectronAPI proxy: invoke() awaits client.invoke, listener() subscribes via client.on; re-shapes thrown errors into plain objects so code/data survive contextBridge.

nodes.name: RoutedClient channel router
nodes.summary: Wraps local + workspace WsRpcClients; LOCAL_ONLY channels go local, everything else to the workspace-owning server; re-subscribes REMOTE_ELIGIBLE listeners on workspace switch (make-before-break) and translates workspace IDs.

nodes.name: RPC_CHANNELS registry
nodes.summary: Nested channel-name registry (sessions, tasks, meetings, skills, memory, voice, fabric, …) forming the wire contract for all RPC.

nodes.name: Channel routing table
nodes.summary: Exhaustive LOCAL_ONLY_CHANNELS vs REMOTE_ELIGIBLE_CHANNELS classification; an exhaustiveness test fails CI until every new channel is classified.

nodes.name: WsRpcServer
nodes.summary: WebSocket implementation of RpcServer: attaches ws WebSocketServer to HTTP or HTTPS, validates tokens/cookies on upgrade, enforces per-handler access + native authorization.

nodes.name: WsRpcClient
nodes.summary: WebSocket RpcClient with automatic reconnection and exponential backoff; usable in renderer (global WebSocket) and Node (ws lib); emits synthetic __transport:reconnected.

nodes.name: Transport interface contracts
nodes.summary: RpcServer/RpcClient/RequestContext/RpcHandlerOptions/EventSink: the shared transport contract for Electron-local and headless hosts.

nodes.name: Headless server entry
nodes.summary: Bun-run standalone Craft Agent server: env contract (CRAFT_SERVER_TOKEN/PORT/TLS/WEBUI_DIR), bootstrapServer, registerCoreRpcHandlers, optional WebUI + messaging workers.

nodes.name: bootstrapServer
nodes.summary: Shared startup used by both Electron main and standalone server; constructs WsRpcServer with native authority, declares native event channels and event projectors.

nodes.name: WebUI HTTP handler
nodes.summary: Serves the browser Control UI from the same RPC host: /login, POST /api/auth, /api/config, /api/config/workspaces, OAuth callback; web-standard handler + node adapter.

nodes.name: Web UI browser entry
nodes.summary: React root for the browser Control-UI build; renders the app that talks to the RPC server over WebSocket.

nodes.name: OmpAgent
nodes.summary: BaseAgent backend that spawns omp --mode rpc (NDJSON stdio): answers extension_ui_request, publishes craft session tools via set_host_tools, maps thinking/tool events, emits omp_turn_anchor for branching.

nodes.name: buildSessionToolDefs
nodes.summary: Builds the host-tool set published into OMP: session tools (spawn_session/call_llm/browser_tool/mcp__session__*) plus MCP source-proxy defs; loadMode 'essential'.

nodes.name: SessionManager
nodes.summary: Owns session lifecycle, OMP process wiring, permission brokering and event fan-out; pushes every session event to RPC_CHANNELS.sessions.EVENT for the workspace.

nodes.name: SessionEventBus
nodes.summary: Typed in-process pub/sub for session lifecycle events (session.created, prompt.assembled, tool.call, session.complete, workspace.idle, …); SessionManager publishes, learning/analytics consume.

nodes.name: MeetingRepository
nodes.summary: Persistent meeting store root; createMeetingRepository(rootDir) opens the journal-backed repository.

nodes.name: Meeting capture IPC
nodes.summary: Electron main IPC handlers START/PAUSE/STOP/STATUS for meeting capture via MEETING_CAPTURE_IPC and registerMeetingCaptureIpc.

nodes.name: LocalMeetingStore
nodes.summary: Local Electron-side meeting store (audio, transcript state, extraction results) persisted for the desktop capture pipeline.

nodes.name: Meetings local contracts
nodes.summary: Shared local meeting types + MEETINGS_LOCAL_IPC: LocalMeeting, LocalTranscript, LocalMeetingExtraction, MeetingsLocalApi.

nodes.name: MeetingJobDispatcher
nodes.summary: Routes meeting/transcript events to multi-role meeting agents with concurrency limits (MEETING_CONCURRENT_JOBS=2) and priority queueing.

nodes.name: planMeetingActions
nodes.summary: Plans meeting action/recipe jobs (slash parsing, recipe binding, follow-up planning) from a meeting profile + source revision.

nodes.name: OMP skill discovery
nodes.summary: Scans ~/.omp/agent/skills, ~/.agents/skills and <ws>/.omp/skills with a 60s TTL cache; listOmpSkills de-dupes by slug; OMP skills are read-only in the UI.

nodes.name: Skill storage and loading
nodes.summary: Roots for global/app-managed/project skills (~/.agents/skills, <config>/skills, .agents/skills) and loadAllSkills/loadWorkspaceSkills with cache invalidation.

nodes.name: Skills.lock reader
nodes.summary: Defines SKILLS_LOCK_FILE and readSkillsLock to parse the pinned pack catalog (slug/origin/commit/license/skills), plus sha/manifest helpers.

nodes.name: SKILLS.lock
nodes.summary: Pinned offline skill-pack catalog (version 2): each pack's upstream origin, commit, license and skill list.

nodes.name: IdentityStore
nodes.summary: Persisted user profile + workspace membership + service-connection state with default profile creation.

nodes.name: InProcessCredentialBroker
nodes.summary: Mints lease-scoped credential access from grants: AccessGrant/CredentialLease types, BrokerDenial errors, audit events; backs the connection fabric.

nodes.name: CredentialManager
nodes.summary: Encrypted credential vault manager (headless + desktop), kind classification and getCredentialManager singleton.

nodes.name: NativeAuthority
nodes.summary: Server-minted principals/credentials for non-Electron clients: authenticate, authorize(action), permissionFence, messaging bindings, self-profile.

nodes.name: CollaborationSyncService
nodes.summary: Server-side collaboration sync over the native journal + native authority (workspace sharing/publication).

nodes.name: Auto-update
nodes.summary: electron-updater integration: GitHub feed rox-one/rox-one, autoDownload, prerelease allowed, download-progress/ready broadcast, ad-hoc-sign detection and feed suppression.

nodes.name: WindowManager
nodes.summary: Owns BrowserWindows per workspace, pushToWindow channel fan-out, mini-window modes and window lookup by webContents/workspace.

nodes.name: OpenClaw host control
nodes.summary: Electron direct-only host control for an OpenClaw runtime: confirmation-gated install/provision/start/stop and an isolated Control-UI window (createControlUiWindowOptions).

nodes.name: Voice overlay window
nodes.summary: Main-process always-on-top dictation overlay window driven by voice overlay IPC.

nodes.name: MemoryService
nodes.summary: Distils sessions into lessons/context: redactSecrets, parseDistillResult and injectable deps; core of the workspace memory subsystem.

nodes.name: Workflow canvas spec
nodes.summary: Defines CanvasNodeKinds/ports/edges, CanvasNode/CanvasEdge, SessionWorkflowSpec and run modes; the data model for the Session Map Canvas.

nodes.name: Language registry
nodes.summary: DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_CODE='ru', SUPPORTED_LANGUAGE_CODES and language metadata; ru is the default UI language.

nodes.name: lint:ipc-sends gate
nodes.summary: Fails if raw webContents/sender/window.send( appears in apps/electron/src/{main,preload} outside a tiny allowlist; forces new IPC through the typed transport.

nodes.name: ROX agent guide
nodes.summary: Binding contributor contract: Bun workflow, OMP backend, host tools, skills sync, i18n all-12-locales rule, runtime 0.11.8 defaults.

nodes.name: buildClientApi
nodes.summary: Builds the ElectronAPI proxy from CHANNEL_MAP; re-shapes errors to plain objects for contextBridge.

nodes.name: RoutedClient
nodes.summary: Client-side channel router selecting local vs workspace WS client and re-binding listeners on workspace switch.

nodes.name: WsRpcServer
nodes.summary: WebSocket RpcServer with upgrade auth, handler access options and native authorization.

nodes.name: WsRpcClient
nodes.summary: Reconnecting WebSocket RpcClient used by renderer, webui and Node hosts.

nodes.name: bootstrapServer
nodes.summary: Shared host startup creating WsRpcServer, native authority and event-channel wiring for both Electron and headless.

nodes.name: OmpAgent
nodes.summary: BaseAgent OMP backend: spawns omp --mode rpc, answers extension_ui_request, registers host tools, emits turn anchors.

nodes.name: buildSessionToolDefs
nodes.summary: Assembles session + MCP-proxy host tool defs published into OMP via set_host_tools.

nodes.name: SessionManager
nodes.summary: Central session lifecycle owner; publishes every event to RPC_CHANNELS.sessions.EVENT.

nodes.name: SessionEventBus
nodes.summary: Typed in-process session lifecycle pub/sub with a no-op default instance.

nodes.name: MeetingRepository
nodes.summary: Journal-backed meeting persistence root created with createMeetingRepository.

nodes.name: LocalMeetingStore
nodes.summary: Electron-main local meeting store for capture/transcript/extraction state.

nodes.name: MeetingJobDispatcher
nodes.summary: Dispatches meeting/transcript events to multi-role agents with concurrency + priority limits.

nodes.name: planMeetingActions
nodes.summary: Plans meeting action/recipe jobs from a profile and source revision.

nodes.name: listOmpSkills
nodes.summary: Enumerates OMP/global/workspace skills, de-duped by slug, with a 60s cache.

nodes.name: loadAllSkills
nodes.summary: Loads global/app-managed/project skills into the merged catalog.

nodes.name: readSkillsLock
nodes.summary: Parses SKILLS.lock into pinned pack metadata.

nodes.name: IdentityStore
nodes.summary: Persisted identity/profile/membership store with default profile creation.

nodes.name: InProcessCredentialBroker
nodes.summary: In-process credential broker issuing lease-scoped access from grants with audit + denial errors.

nodes.name: CredentialManager
nodes.summary: Encrypted credential vault manager and getCredentialManager singleton.

nodes.name: NativeAuthority
nodes.summary: Server-minted principals for native clients with authorize/permissionFence.

nodes.name: CollaborationSyncService
nodes.summary: Server-side collaboration sync over native journal + authority.

nodes.name: Electron IPC bridge
nodes.summary: Renderer reaches main only through window.electronAPI: preload buildClientApi(CHANNEL_MAP) exposes invoke/listener functions over the WS RPC transport, never raw ipcRenderer.

nodes.name: Typed channel map
nodes.summary: Every renderer method maps to a named RPC_CHANNELS entry in channel-map.ts; dotted keys become nested namespaces, and ElectronAPI enforces the shape at compile time.

nodes.name: lint:ipc-sends gate
nodes.summary: scripts/check-raw-sends.sh forbids raw webContents/sender/window.send in main/preload except an allowlist; part of bun run lint.

nodes.name: Local-only vs remote-eligible routing
nodes.summary: Each channel is classified in routing.ts; RoutedClient sends LOCAL_ONLY to the embedded server and the rest to the workspace-owning server.

nodes.name: Embedded WS RPC server
nodes.summary: Electron main hosts an in-process WsRpcServer (same bootstrap as headless) on a local port; renderer/webui connect over WebSocket with token/cookie auth.

nodes.name: WebUI Control UI
nodes.summary: The browser Control UI (apps/webui) is served by createWebuiHandler on the same RPC host, sharing channel routing and auth; the nearest analogue to OpenClaw's Control UI.

nodes.name: OMP RPC runtime
nodes.summary: All sessions run as omp --mode rpc child processes over NDJSON stdio; OmpAgent answers extension_ui_request, negotiates protocol 2 and restores native transcripts.

nodes.name: Per-session event stream
nodes.summary: SessionManager publishes every session event to RPC_CHANNELS.sessions.EVENT ({to:'workspace',workspaceId}); in-process consumers use SessionEventBus. New per-session streams attach here, not via a new socket.

nodes.name: Host tools bridge
nodes.summary: ROX publishes spawn_session/call_llm/browser_tool + MCP source-proxy defs into OMP via set_host_tools; OMP calls back with host_tool_call executed by the craft session registry.

nodes.name: Meetings domain
nodes.summary: Journal + repository + proposals/executor + native capture/finalize/manual intents + evidence/gate op model under server-core/src/meetings.

nodes.name: Local meeting capture
nodes.summary: Electron-main capture (mic/screen), local or cloud ASR, overlay and LocalMeetingStore; MEETINGS_LOCAL_IPC bridges main and renderer.

nodes.name: Meeting agents
nodes.summary: Multi-role meeting agent dispatcher (router) + planning/recipes/policies/extraction producing meeting artifacts, distinct from a channel-joining bot.

nodes.name: Skills catalog
nodes.summary: Pinned 330-skill catalog (SKILLS.lock + REQUESTED-SKILLS.json) synced into the managed skills tier and discovered from OMP/global/workspace roots.

nodes.name: Skill discovery roots
nodes.summary: omp-discovery scans ~/.omp/agent/skills, ~/.agents/skills and <ws>/.omp/skills with a TTL cache; storage.ts adds <config>/skills and .agents/skills.

nodes.name: Identity fabric
nodes.summary: IdentityStore + profile/workspace membership/service connections in packages/core/src/platform/identity, exposed via identity RPC channels.

nodes.name: Credentials fabric
nodes.summary: Connection Fabric: InProcessCredentialBroker grants/leases, OS/cloud importers (keychain, AWS, SSH agent, GitHub OAuth), header-delivery and materialization.

nodes.name: Native authority
nodes.summary: NativeAuthority mints principals for non-Electron clients and enforces authorize/permissionFence; NativePrincipal bounds every native handler.

nodes.name: Multi-user collaboration
nodes.summary: Workspace membership + orgs + CollaborationSyncService + presence + session publication form ROX's multi-user layer (server-side, journal-backed).

nodes.name: Auto-update
nodes.summary: electron-updater against the rox-one/rox-one GitHub feed with prerelease allowed, download-progress/ready broadcast and ad-hoc-sign/feed suppression guards.

nodes.name: Installer packaging
nodes.summary: electron-builder.yml ships macOS dmg/zip, Windows nsis, Linux AppImage; dist:* scripts build per platform.

nodes.name: Russian-first i18n
nodes.summary: ru is the default UI language; all user-facing strings go through t() and every new key must be added to all 12 locale files with ASCII-sorted parity gates.

nodes.name: macOS shell
nodes.summary: Electron main owns native windows, menu, deep links, notifications, power management, native replica and the embedded server lifecycle.

nodes.name: Workflow canvas
nodes.summary: SessionWorkflowSpec with CanvasNode/CanvasEdge is the existing canvas/graph model (with a canvas-spec test) and the nearest analogue to a canvas/workboard surface.

nodes.name: Kanban workboard
nodes.summary: KanbanBoardConfig/columns plus the workgraph server module back task-board style workboard views.

nodes.name: Memory service
nodes.summary: MemoryService distils sessions into lessons/context (redactSecrets, parseDistillResult); proposal store + fts index + learning pipeline surround it.

nodes.name: Voice runtime
nodes.summary: Shared voice runtime (contracts, job machine, transcription, history, hotkeys) plus a main-process overlay window and dictation host; meeting-stream bridges into meetings.

nodes.name: OpenClaw host control
nodes.summary: ROX already hosts an OpenClaw runtime: direct-only Electron host control (confirmation-gated install/provision/start/stop + isolated Control-UI window) plus server-side runtime manager and audit.

nodes.name: ROX port target surface
nodes.summary: The mapping from OpenClaw feature areas (a1/b1/b2/c1/c2/d1/d2/e1/e2) onto ROX files: channels to routing to server-core domain, with i18n and IPC-lint cross-cutting gates.
